item.title: About
item.description: Currently working as a quantitative researcher, blending code, data, and curiosity. I’ve worked across backend systems, game development, and AI research—always driven by the urge to build and explore new ideas. I enjoy thoughtful technical discussions, whether they lead to real solutions or just spark new questions. This blog gathers the artifacts from that journey: quant models, deep learning experiments, and the occasional tangent that helps make sense of both.

item.title: Hello World
item.description: First post from the desk of a quant researcher. Expect short riffs on market structure, model failures, and deep learning experiments—light on ceremony, heavy on curiosity.
